records.jp: ふむ……デスマーチか
records.en_original: Hm... A death march, you say?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. A death march, you say?
records.en: Hm... A death march, you say?

records.jp: （あっ、何だか危険な単語が聞こえた……）
records.en_original: (Uh, that's not a good sign...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Uh, that's not a good sign.)
records.en: (Uh, that's not a good sign...)

records.jp: 有理、史緒……もしかして、デスマーチの話？
records.en_original: Yuri, Fumio... Please tell me you're not talking about death marches.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri, Fumio... Please tell me you're not talking about death marches.
records.en: Yuri, Fumio... Please tell me you're not talking about death marches.

records.jp: あら、白井さん。<CR>ええ、まさにその通りよ
records.en_original: Ah, Shirai. Yes, you hit the nail right on the head!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Shirai. Yes, that's exactly what we were discussing!
records.en: Ah, Shirai-san. Yes, you hit the nail right on the head!

records.jp: ピアノで上達するために意識していることを尋ねられたから、<CR>やっぱりデスマかなって思ったの
records.en_original: She asked me about how to improve at the piano, and the death march method immediately sprang to mind.
records.en_auxiliary: She asked me about how to improve at the piano, and the death march method immediately sprang to mind.
records.en: She asked me about how to improve at the piano, and the death march method immediately sprang to mind.

records.jp: （そ、それで以前倒れて叱られたんじゃなかったっけ……？）
records.en_original: (The same death march method that left you collapsed in a heap and earned you a harsh talking to...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (The same death march method that left you collapsed in a heap and earned you a harsh talking to?)
records.en: (The same death march method that left you collapsed in a heap and earned you a harsh talking to...?)

records.jp: 人間、やはり極限までいかねば限界を超えることは<CR>できないのかもしれないな……
records.en_original: It would seem humans need to be pushed to their utmost limits in order to exceed them.
records.en_auxiliary: It would seem humans need to be pushed to their utmost limits in order to exceed them.
records.en: It would seem humans need to be pushed to their utmost limits in order to exceed them.

records.jp: 私も研究で徹夜をしたことはあるが、<CR>精神が追いつめられるほどの経験はまだしていない
records.en_original: I've stayed up all night doing research before, but it was never something that pushed my spirit to its brink.
records.en_auxiliary: I've stayed up all night doing research before, but it was never something that pushed my spirit to its brink.
records.en: I've stayed up all night doing research before, but it was never something that pushed my spirit to its brink.

records.jp: 私もデスマーチというものを経験してみれば、<CR>極限に近づいた人の感情を理解できそうだ
records.en_original: Perhaps if I experience a death march, I could understand the feelings of people pushed to the extreme.
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps, if I experience a death march, I could understand the feelings of people pushed to the extreme.
records.en: Perhaps if I experience a death march, I could understand the feelings of people pushed to the extreme.

records.jp: え……まさか、有理もデスマーチを実践する気……？
records.en_original: Please don't tell me you actually want to try this...
records.en_auxiliary: Please don't tell me you actually want to try this...
records.en: Please don't tell me you actually want to try this...

records.jp: そ、それをやるのは最後に回した方がいいんじゃないかな？<CR>他のことをしていたらわかることかもしれないし
records.en_original: Sh-shouldn't that be a last resort? You might be able to figure things out through other means.
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-shouldn't that be a last resort? You might be able to figure things out through other means.
records.en: Sh-shouldn't that be a last resort? You might be able to figure things out through other means.

records.jp: そうか？　しかし……
records.en_original: Do you think so? Still...
records.en_auxiliary: Do you think so? Still...
records.en: Do you think so? Still...

records.jp: ほ、ほら、一般的な感情の理解を深める方が大事でしょ？<CR>デスマーチで体を壊したら、そっちに手が回らなくなるよ
records.en_original: Y-you're trying to learn more about emotions, right? Making yourself sick with a death march would keep you from that...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you're trying to learn more about emotions, right? Making yourself sick with a death march would keep you from that.
records.en: Y-you're trying to learn more about emotions, right? Making yourself sick with a death march would keep you from that...

records.jp: ふむ……それはそうだな
records.en_original: Hm... That's true.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. That's true.
records.en: Hm... That's true.

records.jp: （良かった、思いとどまってくれた――）
records.en_original: (What a relief, I think that should keep her from--)
records.en_auxiliary: (What a relief, I think that should keep her from—)
records.en: (What a relief, I think that should keep her from--)

records.jp: しかし、人の極限状態というものには俄然興味が湧く。<CR>やはり後で実践してみるとしよう
records.en_original: However, I'm suddenly interested to know how people feel in extreme situations. I really should try it out later.
records.en_auxiliary: However, I'm suddenly interested to know how people feel in extreme situations. I really should try it out later.
records.en: However, I'm suddenly interested to know how people feel in extreme situations. I really should try it out later.

records.jp: （……あ、ダメだ。止められそうにない）
records.en_original: (...Ugh, it's no use. I can't stop her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ugh, it's no use. I can't stop her.)
records.en: (...Ugh, it's no use. I can't stop her.)

records.jp: ふふふ。やっぱり私もそのくらいしないとだよね。<CR>限界を超える前に、限界に近づくのが先だもの
records.en_original: Hehehe. I need to do the same. You need to reach your limit before you can exceed it, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. I need to do the same. You need to reach your limit before you can exceed it, after all.
records.en: Hehehe. I need to do the same. You need to reach your limit before you can exceed it, after all.

records.jp: なるほど……参考までに聞きたいんだが、デスマーチを<CR>経験するにはどのような方法を取ればいいのだろうか
records.en_original: That seems reasonable. For reference, what method should I use to induce a death march?
records.en_auxiliary: That seems reasonable. For reference, what method should I use to induce a death march?
records.en: That seems reasonable. For reference, what method should I use to induce a death march?

records.jp: 私は徹夜でピアノを弾き続けてたけど、<CR>斎木さんの場合だと何がいいのかしら……？
records.en_original: I play the piano all night without rest, but I wonder what would be best in your case...
records.en_auxiliary: I play the piano all night without rest, but I wonder what would be best in your case...
records.en: I kept playing piano all night, but<CR>I wonder what would work for you, Saiki-san...

records.jp: （こ、この二人は、出会っちゃいけなかった気がする……）
records.en_original: (I-I feel like these two shouldn't have ever been allowed to meet...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I-I feel like these two shouldn't have ever been allowed to meet.)
records.en: (I-I feel like these two shouldn't have ever been allowed to meet...)

records.jp: む、無理をするのは良くないよ。<CR>体を壊しちゃったら元も子もないでしょ？
records.en_original: I-it's not good to overdo it. You can't do much research if you're sick, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I-It's not good to overdo it. You can't do much research if you get sick, right?
records.en: I-it's not good to overdo it. You can't do much research if you're sick, right?

records.jp: それに、史緒も以前それで倒れちゃったんだから、<CR>やっぱり危険だよ
records.en_original: Besides, Fumio collapsed due to one of her death marches before. It's really dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, Fumio collapsed due to one of her death marches before. It's really dangerous.
records.en: Besides, Fumio collapsed due to one of her death marches before. It's really dangerous.

records.jp: そうね……。ぜひ斎木さんにもデスマを経験してもらいたい<CR>ところだけど……
records.en_original: Fair point... I did want Saiki to experience what a death march is like, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Fair point. I did want Saiki to experience what a death march is like, but...
records.en: Fair point... I did want Saiki-san to experience what a death march is like, but...

records.jp: 健康を考えるとここは止めるべきよね。<CR>そうでなくても斎木さん、体力なさそうなんだし……
records.en_original: For the sake of her health, she probably shouldn't. I can't imagine it would end well, given how frail she looks...
records.en_auxiliary: For the sake of her health, she probably shouldn't. I can't imagine it would end well, given how frail she looks.
records.en: For her health, we should probably stop her.<CR>Saiki-san doesn't look like she has much stamina anyway...

records.jp: ふ、史緒、全部口に出てる……。<CR>説得力なくなっちゃうから……
records.en_original: F-Fumio, you might want to put a filter between your mind and your mouth. You might actually be egging her on...
records.en_auxiliary: F-Fumio, you might want to put a filter between your mind and your mouth. You might actually be egging her on.
records.en: F-Fumio, you might want to put a filter between your mind and your mouth. You might actually be egging her on...

records.jp: ふむ……よくわからないが、<CR>やめておいた方がいいということか
records.en_original: Hm... I'm not certain I understand your resasoning, but it seems that I shouldn't attempt it.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. I'm not certain I understand your reasoning, but it seems that I shouldn't attempt it.
records.en: Hm... I'm not certain I understand your resasoning, but it seems that I shouldn't attempt it.

records.jp: う、うん。そういうこと
records.en_original: Y-Yeah, that's what we're saying.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah, that's what we're saying.
records.en: Y-Yeah, that's what we're saying.

records.jp: それならば、経験談を聞かせてもらっても構わないだろうか？<CR>体験は出来なくとも、何か得るものがあるかもしれない
records.en_original: In that case, could you just tell me about your experience? Testimony might be valuable in lieu of trying it myself.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, could you just tell me about your experience? Testimony might be valuable in lieu of trying it myself.
records.en: In that case, could you just tell me about your experience? Testimony might be valuable in lieu of trying it myself.

records.jp: ええ、大丈夫よ
records.en_original: Sure, not a problem at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, not a problem at all.
records.en: Sure, not a problem at all.

records.jp: ええと、そうね……最初は色んな考えが頭の中を巡ってるんだけど、<CR>次第に意識が朦朧としてきて無心になって……
records.en_original: Hmm... First, all kinds of ideas swirl around my head, then my awareness dims, freeing me from unnecessary thoughts...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... First, all kinds of ideas swirl around my head, then my awareness dims, freeing me from unnecessary thoughts.
records.en: Hmm... First, all kinds of ideas swirl around my head, then my awareness dims, freeing me from unnecessary thoughts...

records.jp: なるほど、それが極限に近づいている状態なのか……。<CR>そして、それが続くとどうなるんだ？
records.en_original: I see, so that's one's mental state as they approach their limits... What happens after that?
records.en_auxiliary: I see, so that's one's mental state as they approach their limits. What happens after that?
records.en: I see, so that's one's mental state as they approach their limits... What happens after that?

records.jp: ええとね、言葉でまとめられるかしら……。<CR>こう、ふわふわして、光がきらきらして――
records.en_original: Well, it's hard to explain in words... It's sort of this soft, fluffy feeling, or bright and shiny...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it's hard to explain in words... It's sort of this soft, fluffy feeling, or bright and shiny.
records.en: Well, it's hard to explain in words... It's sort of this soft, fluffy feeling, or bright and shiny...

records.jp: （この二人……出会わせちゃいけなかったかも……）
records.en_original: (It might have been better if these two never met...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It might have been better if these two never met.)
records.en: (It might have been better if these two never met...)

records.jp: 有理――
records.en_original: Yuri...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri...
records.en: Yuri...
